sections.heading: MAJOR IN CATHOLIC STUDIES
lines: Completion of first-year requirements. Religious Studies 1027E is recommended.
3.5 courses from: Religious Studies 2201F/G, Religious Studies 2202F/G, Religious Studies 2203F/G, Religious Studies 2205F/G, Religious Studies 2207E, Religious Studies 2294F/G.
1.0 course: Religious Studies 2271F/G and Religious Studies 2272F/G.
1.0 additional course in Religious Studies at the 2200 level or above, except Religious Studies 2208U, Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y.
0.5 additional course in Religious Studies at the 3000 level or above, except Religious Studies 3308U and Religious Studies 4408Y.
Note: Students admitted to an Honours Double Major must complete 1.0 course at the 3000-level or above in each major. Choose your courses accordingly.

Note: This module requires Religious Studies 2203F/G, which has Religious Studies 1023E as an antirequisite. Students who have completed Religious Studies 1023E must substitute an alternate 0.5 course in Religious Studies at the 2200 level.
Note: Students should be aware of the following course sequencing issues with respect to this module:
1) Religious Studies 2271F/G and Religious Studies 2272F/G cannot normally be taken until at least third year as they require prerequisites of Religious Studies 2201F/G and Religious Studies 2202F/G.
2) The Department of Philosophy and Religious Studies offers certain courses in alternate years; students are responsible for checking the Departmental Website for course rotation information.
